passages.label: Metà di voi quà vadano … lontan non sia di quà

Se un uom' e una ragazza (again) · ferite!
Metà di voi quà vadano (again) · Andate, fate presto!

licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (quà with its accent, lontan non sia di quà, no!, uom', passeggiam, dobbiam, fa-re al-la-mor hyphenated with no apostrophe in bar 15; the libretto has qua, non fia, uom, passeggian, dobbiamo and all'amor).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 177–182, bars 1–85 of No. 17
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung line and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker. The English singing translation, the stage directions and the instrument cues are left out; Masetto and the peasants are on stage but do not sing. Don Giovanni, disguised as Leporello, sings in the bass clef at sounding pitch. Bar 1 is the printed one-sixteenth upbeat (Me-), written as a bar of 1/16 before the 4/4 from bar 2. The piano's left hand in bar 7 is garbled in the print and is written as in the parallel bar 50. Bars 78–85 are for the piano alone. Playback tempo: Andante con moto ♩ = 114, about 2:57, the median of five complete recordings whose track holds the aria alone (Fricsay 1958 2:54, Giulini 1959 3:12, Klemperer 1966 3:21, Böhm 1967 2:57, Karajan 1985 2:52); Mozart gives the words only.
